# Repository instructions

The authoritative guidance for humans and AI coding agents working in this
repository lives in [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) at the repository root
(`CLAUDE.md` is a symlink to the same file). Read and follow it before making
any changes — it covers repo layout, the required Python toolchain
(`mise`/`uv`), how to run Q# examples, and conventions for adding new
examples and docs.
